title: Additional issues, questions, and settings mentions
summary: This topic mixes follow-up statements about no additional problems after repairs with unrelated mentions of extra questions, desired features, and menu settings.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe resolved issues with no additional problems reported after replacement or repair actions.

negative.summary: Negative-labeled reviews also state that no additional issues or problems occurred after service, so the negative assignment is not explained by the excerpt alone.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention additional questions, extra settings, limited troubleshooting time, and requests for more storage or customization without clear sentiment in the excerpt.

limitations: The cluster mixes several unrelated subjects, including post-repair follow-up, feature requests, customer availability, and menu navigation.
Several negative-labeled excerpts read positive on their face, so the sentiment label cannot be fully interpreted from the fragment alone.
Many undetermined fragments are short or procedural, which limits confidence in identifying a consistent customer issue.
